description: Search live dealer-direct New, Used, and Certified Pre-Owned car inventory across participating US franchise dealerships in 9 states. Supports natural free-text query, condition ('new', 'used', 'certified'), state, city, region, make, model, trim, year_min/year_max, price_max, mileage_max, zip + radius_miles (geo search), fuel_type, drivetrain, transmission, body_style, certified_only, and dealer_id. Every vehicle includes freshness timestamps (last_seen_at), price_status ('verified' vs 'suspect'), and a direct link to the dealer's own VDP (source_url). Empty searches return closest-match suggestions.

certified_only.description: If true, only return factory Certified Pre-Owned (CPO) vehicles.

condition.description: Filter by vehicle condition ('new', 'used', or 'certified'). Omit to search all conditions.

limit.description: Max vehicles to return per page (1-100, default: 20).

query.description: Optional free-text search query (e.g., 'new SUV', 'used AWD', 'Ford Explorer', 'Honda Civic').

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles from the ZIP centroid (default: 25, max: 500).

region.description: Regional market filter (e.g., 'South Florida', 'Central Florida', 'Tampa Bay', 'North Florida', 'Atlanta', 'Texas', 'Carolinas', 'West').

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code for geo-radius search (e.g., '33140' for Miami Beach, '33169' for Miami Gardens).

name: search_inventory
title: Search Dealer-Direct New & Used Car Inventory
